name: Contest Scout
tagline: Works X and Facebook giveaways end to end and flags win notices in your inbox
description: Point it at giveaway posts on X and Facebook and it works through each one's entry steps - following, liking, reposting or commenting as required - on a rhythm you set, skipping off-site entry forms. It confirms every required action landed, watches your inbox for winning notifications, and happily chats between draws.
author: julis555
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
